dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-dorsal region displays several prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped rings. The geometry of the perimeters is irregular with sharp, high-contrast transitions from dark grey/black outer edges to lighter interior grey tones. One specific 'C' shape on the upper dorsal midline shows a jagged, non-uniform gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of light-colored, high-intensity pixel clusters along the upper dorsal ridge. These clusters lack internal gradients and are concentrated most heavily in the area between the neck and the mid-back, forming a dense, speckled mosaic.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest side extending laterally toward the left flank. Connecting these with the centroids of the primary light-intensity blobs creates a complex polygonal network across the dorsal surface.
